JwtSettings._comment: Secret is intentionally not set here. Non-Development environments fail to start without a real value (see Program.cs's fail-fast checks) — set it via User Secrets locally, or an environment variable / secret store in any real deployment. Never commit a real value.

_workerSecretKeyComment: WorkerSecretKey (flat key, read by ConfigurationWorkerKeyResolver) is intentionally not set here — same rule as JwtSettings:Secret above. WORKER_SECRET_KEY as an env var works too.
_ecfEmisorComment: Rnc was found committed as '101672919' — a generic test-fixture RNC reused across unrelated customer/RFCE unit test data, NOT the real emisor RNC (confirmed elsewhere as 101889063, e.g. ERPConnector's own Dgii:RncEmisor). Left blank rather than guess-corrected: ValidateOnStart() now requires this outside Development, so a real value must be set consciously via configuration (env var / user secrets), not inherited from an accidental default. RazonSocial is confirmed consistent with ERPConnector's own config.
